title: How many of my picks do you agree with?  Let me know yours in the com...
transcript: I've officially seen every single show eligible for the Tonys this year, so let's talk 2026 Tony predictions. And let's start with Best Musical. In my mind, this category will very likely be Schmigadoon, two Strangers, Lost Boys, and Titanique. And I have those exact same shows for Best Book of a musical as well. Best play is a little bit more competitive. Once again, we only have four nominees, and my picks were Giant, Liberation, Balusters, and then Little Bear Ridge Road. Although personally I would probably nominate fear of 13 in that fourth spot. Then we have musical revival. I have Cats, Ragtime, and Rocky Horror. Could chess get in? Maybe, but personally I think these three are stronger For play revival, We are finally back up to five nominees! How exciting! This one also is really tough to predict. I have death of a Salesman, oedipus, Becky Shaw, Joe Turner's come and  gone, and proof. But like Bug, Marjorie Prime, every brilliant thing, Fallen Angels could all easily slip in. Moving on to the acting categories, we have Best Actress in a musical. I have Caissie Levy, Marla Mindelle, Sara Chase, Lea Michele, and Christiani Pitts. I would love to see Jessica Vosk slip into this category for her work in beaches, but I just don't know that it happens. I also think Stephanie Hsu would be a fun surprise nom, but I do think they kind of screwed her putting her in lead rather than featured. Then We have Best Actor in a musical, and this one I also feel pretty confident in. I have Josh Henry, Sam Tutty, Luke Evans, Nic Christopher, and Brandon Uranowitz. Next we have another competitive category with Best Actress in a play. I ended up with Lesley Manville, Susannah Flood, Ayo Edebiri, Carrie Coon, and Rose Byrne. I also considered Kelli O'hara and Anika Noni Rose, but I think some of these actresses just have more flashy roles. For best Actor in a play, I have John Lithgow, Nathan Lane, Daniel Radcliffe, Adrien Brody, and Jon Bernthal. For best featured actors in a musical, this one is tough. I ended up with Shoshana Bean, Tempress, Nichelle Lewis, Shaina Taub, and Mckenzie Kurtz. But in My Dream of Dreams, Hannah Cruz from chess and Nina White from Queen of Versailles also somehow make it into this category. For best featured actor in a musical, I have Andre De Shields, Ben Levi Ross, Ali Louis Bourzgui, Layton Williams, and Jim Parsons. You could also make a case for Constantine Rousouli or Sydney James Harcourt. For Featured Actress in a play, I have Laurie Metcalf, June Squibb, Betsy Aidem, Kara Young, and Marylouise Burke. For best featured actor in a play, I have Alden Ehrenreich, Christopher Abbott, Ruben Santiago-Hudson, Danny Burstein, and my dark horse pick Richard Thomas. I'd also see a strong case for Cedric the entertainer Also for Joe Turner's, but I think they're gonna Wanna Spread the Love finally, the creative categories. For best direction of a musical, I have Zhailon Levingston and Bill Rauch, Lear DeBessonet, Michael Arden, Chris Gattelli, and Sam Pinkleton. For best director of a play, I ultimately went with Whitney White, Joe Mantello, Robert Ike, Anne Kauffman, and Trip Cullman. For best original score, I went with two Strangers Carry a Cake, Schmigadoon, Lost Boys, and then death of a salesman and proof. Meaning I do think our two other original musical scores, Queen of Versailles and beaches, do get left out here. Then finally, for Best Choreography, I have cats the Jellicle ball, schmigadoon, Rocky Horror Show, Lost Boys, and chess.
